pr.title: feat(governance): add audit-safe pal clink configs
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds claude-audit and gemini-audit PAL MCP clink client configs for proof-only audit prep.
- Maps both default and codereviewer roles to systemprompts/clink/default_codereviewer.txt because clink registry injects/defaults default.
- Records Copilot audit config as DEFERRED_COPILOT_RUNNER_UNSUPPORTED; no Copilot runner support or auditor-router integration is included.

## Scope
Config, focused tests, clink docs, task packet, and proof only. No clink runtime internals, auditor-router code, schemas, scripts, docs/ops, or GitHub workflow changes.

## Validation
Run the REV2 JSON, pytest, compileall, proof JSON, diff, and status commands before review.

## NOT_RUN
- Authenticated CLI prompts
- Auditor-router integration
- Embedded audit verdict capture
- Copilot runner/parser implementation

@codex review
@gemini
@copilot

Docs record default and codereviewer role equivalence for audit configs.
